summary: Wheaton Precious Metals filed a Form 6-K on November 6, 2026, attaching a November 5 news release with third-quarter 2026 results, MD&A, interim financial statements, and CEO/CFO certifications. The release reported Q3 revenue of $772 million, net earnings of $410 million, operating cash flow of $645 million, and a declared quarterly dividend of $0.195 per share. It also noted a $1.6 billion term loan and revolver balance after repaying $372 million, and operational updates at Salobo, Kon, Platreef, Goose, Kurmuk, Copper World, Jervois, and Marathon. No special-situation transaction was announced.
